rows.note: For the sweet substance, use 蜜糖 as the all-purpose choice.

example.english: I like using honey to make tea.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 jung6 mat6 tong4 cung1 caa4

rows.note: Use 寶貝 as a familiar term of affection for a loved one.

example.traditional: 寶貝，你今日食咗飯未呀？
example.jyutping: bou2 bui3 nei5 gam1 jat6 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use 靚女 when referring casually to an attractive woman rather than addressing someone affectionately.

example.english: That honey reads at the café every day.
example.traditional: 嗰個靚女成日喺咖啡店睇書。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 leng3 neoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 gaa3 fe1 dim3 tai2 syu1
